title: knot-crossing-toggle widget params
description: Click any crossing of a knot diagram to flip which strand passes over; the Kauffman bracket state sum, writhe, and Jones polynomial recompute live, and the readout names the resulting knot (unknot, left/right trefoil, figure-eight). The diagram is a fixed closed curve; its crossings, arcs, and PD code are derived from the curve's self-intersections at init, so the picture and the algebra cannot drift apart.

widgetId.description: DOM id for the outer <div class="widget"> wrapper.

svgTitle.description: Accessible <title> for the svg; defaults to title.

template.description: Diagram template: 'trefoil' is the 3-crossing curve (reaches both trefoils and the unknot); 'four' is the 4-crossing curve (reaches the figure-eight, both trefoils, and the unknot).

initialOver.description: Boot over/under bits, one per crossing (true = earlier strand passage on top). Defaults: figure-eight state [false,true,false,false] for 'four', alternating trefoil [true,false,true] for 'trefoil'.
